profile.headline: Sr. Software Developer at General Dynamics Information Technology (GDIT)

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Working for GDIT on the CDC project - National Electronic Disease Surveillance System Base System (NBS)

Providing end-to-end support for the NBS application, including troubleshooting, enhancements, and deployments.
Ensuring the continued optimization of NBS’s application to meet evolving business needs.
Led various integrations with external systems, including immunization (IIS) and DIBBS Viewer, ensuring seamless data flow and system interoperability.
Managed migration efforts from JBoss to WildFly, enhancing application performance and streamlining deployment processes.
Expertise in data migration and transformation, ensuring accurate, efficient, and secure handling of data across systems.
In-depth knowledge of CDA, HL7, and FHIR standards, leveraging these to support seamless healthcare data exchange and integration.
Created/updated stored procedures to generate various reports, ensuring accurate and timely delivery of critical data insights.
Implemented load balancing strategies to manage higher traffic loads, especially during peak times like COVID, ensuring application stability and availability.
Focused on application performance improvement, optimizing key areas to reduce latency and enhance user experience.
Designed the application to be configurable, enabling the ability to turn features on/off dynamically based on configuration, improving flexibility and adaptability to client needs.
Responsible for developing and implementing database-related changes to improve performance and scalability.
Collaborating with client teams to ensure smooth integration and effective deployment of new features.
Led application enhancement to address and fix security vulnerabilities, ensuring system integrity and compliance.
positions.insights: HL7 Standards, Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources (FHIR) and +1 skill
